subject: Operations
title: Freight Consolidation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Freight Consolidation usable.

hook.text: Shipping a half-empty truck costs nearly as much as shipping a full one. Fill it up and the per-unit cost plummets.

buildup.text: Freight consolidation combines smaller shipments into one full load to reduce per-unit transportation costs.

discovery.text: LTL carriers specialize in combining partial loads from multiple shippers onto a single truck.

twist.text: Consolidation adds time because shipments wait to be grouped. Speed and savings pull in opposite directions.

climax.text: Milk runs—a single truck visiting multiple suppliers in sequence—consolidate pickups into one efficient route.

punchline.text: Fill the truck. Split the cost. Everyone saves.
